questions.question: How did Job describe his complaint?
options: Already wholly settled and at peace
Heavier than the sand of the sea
questions.answer: Heavier than the sand of the sea

questions.question: What did Job say about his friends?
options: They were treacherous like a dried-up brook
They had truly helped him in his pain
They were wise and spoke only truth
They had stayed far away from him in his trouble
questions.answer: They were treacherous like a dried-up brook

questions.question: Job wished that God would grant his request and crush him to end his suffering.
